annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and nonempty Fin indexing

assumptions: The input has paper length N=n+1.
Rounded addition follows the shared standard relative-error rule and copies an initial value from zero exactly.
TwoSum returns the rounded high component, preserves the exact local sum, and bounds its low component by u times the high magnitude.
The abstract addition contract covers the paper's addition-underflow case; multiplication is not used.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header:
theorem p02_t1_sum2_error_bound
    (fp : ErrorFreeAddModel) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
    (hvalid : GammaValid fp.u (n + 1)) :
    |sum2 fp v - ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), v i| ≤
      fp.u * |∑ i : Fin (n + 1), v i| +
        (gamma fp.u n) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), |v i|
formal_statement.plain_language: Sum2 has absolute error at most u times the exact-sum magnitude plus gamma(u,N-1) squared times the input absolute mass.

informal_proof: Use Lemma 4.2 for the emitted lows, the ordinary recursive-summation estimate for their accumulation, exact preservation by VecSum, and the final rounded-addition model; then apply (1+u)gamma_(N-2) <= gamma_(N-1).
informal_statement: For a nonempty input vector, Algorithm 4.4 (Sum2) satisfies |res-s| <= u|s| + gamma(u,N-1)^2 sum_i |v_i|.
paper_version: journal version; volume 26, issue 6, 2005, printed pages 1955-1988

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The recursive-summation theorem supplies the substantial estimate in equation (4.11). Compensated-summation declarations in the library use a different execution and are not counted.

Its other NumStability references are representation adapters or elementary gamma facts. The VecSum invariant and Lemma 4.2 remain paper-specific in both proofs.
